# BS 7671 regulation numbers that exist — the allow-list for citation checks.
#
# Exported from the project's own BS 7671 data on 2026-09-27:
#   select reg_number from bs7671_known_reg_numbers
#   union select reg_number from bs7671_regulations
#   where reg_number ~ '^[1-8][0-9]{2}(\.[0-9]+)*$'
#
# Why this file exists: the Welsh course and several English lessons cited
# "Regulation 311.2" (does not exist — load curtailment is 722.311.201) and
# "Regulation 514.16" for single-pole switching (514.16.1 is the SPD-presence
# label; single-pole in the line conductor is 132.14.1). Both read perfectly
# plausibly and both were wrong. A number that cannot be found here has not
# been verified, and must not be published.
#
# A handful of entries are OCR artefacts of real numbers (411.31, 514.122).
# They are kept rather than filtered so the list never rejects something the
# source data does hold; the check below is for catching INVENTED numbers.
# Section and group headings (642, 643, Section 443) are not in this list and
# are handled separately by the checker.
